P.name: Illumination
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lux's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a mark to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

'''Lux's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Final Spark|Lux}}'' consume the mark to deal {{as|{{pplevel|30 to 200}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

Q.name: Light Binding
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' shoots a sphere of light in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first two enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for 2 seconds.

W.name: Prismatic Barrier
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' throws her wand in the target direction that homes back to her after reaching maximum range. Allied champions hit by the wand gain a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, which can stack up to 2 times, stacking with the previous shield and refreshing its duration.
W.leveling: {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Shield|{{ap|40*2 to 100*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: '''Lux''' gains the shield upon throwing and upon retrieving the wand.
W.cast time: {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Effect starts at beginning of cast time}}

E.name: Lucent Singularity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' sends a lucent singularity to the target location, remaining there for 5 seconds to grant {{tip|sight}} of the area and {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies.
E.description2: ''Lucent Singularity'' can be recast at any time while it is in flight or within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lux''' detonates the singularity, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within. If ''Lucent Singularity'' was recast while in flight, it will detonate upon arrival.
E.description4: The slow lingers for 1 second after leaving the area. Enemies hit by ''Lucent Singularity's'' detonation are also slowed by the same amount for 1 second.

R.name: Final Spark
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lux''' fires a massive light beam in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as grants {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area.
